description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the dashboard screen of a mobile finance app, displaying monthly summaries, category budget progress, and a month picker.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget for the dashboard, displaying summary cards for categories and a month picker.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dashboard's data loading and rendering logic.

classes.name: _MonthPickerBar
classes.description: Stateless widget providing a UI component to select months.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and triggers data load for dashboard summaries.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying loading, error, empty states, or category summaries.

methods.name: _MonthPickerBar.build
methods.description: Builds the UI component with previous/next month buttons and current month display.
